reason: PDG text: 'B0 --> Dbar_2^*(2460)- pi+ , D^*_2()- --> D0 pi-'. A D_2*(2460)- (anti-c d) decays strongly to Dbar0 pi-; D0 pi- would change charm by two units. The listing means Dbar0 pi-, as it writes for S042.320 and S042.419.
PDG text: 'B0 --> Dbar_0^*(2400)- pi+ , D^*_0()- --> D0 pi-'. Same misprint as S042.124: a D_0*- decays to Dbar0 pi-, as the listing writes for S042.554 and S042.418.
PDG text: 'B0 --> D_sJ(2457)+ D^*(2010) , D_sJ()+ --> D_s()+ gamma', without the charge of the D*. Charge conservation in a B0 decay with a D_sJ+ fixes it to D*(2010)-.
